quote_zh: Diese Seite traegt genau ein Diagramm, ein Spektrum, das um 90 Grad gedreht quer auf dem Blatt gedruckt ist ... das Spektrum ist also als Absorption (Extinktion) nach oben aufgetragen und nicht als Transmission nach unten ... alle Lagen NUR UNGEFAEHR vom Diagramm abgelesen (Unsicherheit in der Groessenordnung von einigen 10 cm-1); die genauen Werte stehen in Tabelle 2 und sind von dort zu nehmen ... Abbildung 1a zeigt das Infrarot-Spektrum der Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione.
notes: The sheet itself names no substance. Lines 835, 837, 839 are the vision pass's German description of the plot on this drawing sheet, not prose printed in the patent; the only text actually printed on the sheet is the caption Fig. 1a, the running header and the axis label Wellenzahl cm-1, and no y axis title or unit is printed at all. Line 96 is cited because the figure-to-modification mapping, and with it the identity of the record and whether the spectrum is Raman or infrared, is taken from [0018] of the description on a different page; it is an inference from that paragraph and not a reading of this sheet. [0018] calls the object Abbildung 1a while the sheet prints Fig. 1a. No band position was carried into the record as data; value and unit are null and the exact maxima stay in Tabellen 1 and 2. The vision pass and this reading are both model output, so a feature the vision pass missed on the plot cannot be seen here. Aliases: every candidate from the shared briefing's canonical table was checked as a literal substring before writing this file. None of the German names of the modifications occurs anywhere in this section's lines, so the record carries an empty aliases array rather than a spelling borrowed from another page. The two composed forms 'metastabile Kristallmodifikation II' and 'metastabile Kristallmodifikation III', which an earlier revision of the briefing listed as aliases, occur nowhere in the enriched document at all and are not used.
